cand.title: Rail Day 2027
cand.organizationName: Transit Rail Association for Canadian Contractors, Maintainers, Operators and Standards (TRACCS)

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Andrea Roncoroni Martins is the primary organizer-side commercial routing contact: a TRACCS-issued January 2026 release names her Business Manager; the live 2027 page directs sponsorship and conference questions to Andrea at andrear@traccs.ca. Cheryl Pineo is explicitly named as leading HPN Global’s historical 2026 sourcing support; ask Andrea whether that mandate continues for 2027. Mark Salsberg, Chairperson & Co-Founder, is an executive relationship/escalation route, not a verified housing buyer. Anne Dombrowe, Rail.S office manager / manager for fairs and conferences, is a published contact for the proposed 2027 ERCI delegation, a separate prospective sub-group route. No person’s authority to sign a 2027 hotel contract is established.
findings.futureEdition: Official activity dates are June 16–17, 2027, within the requested horizon. The organizer says “RAIL DAY 2027 TORONTO | JUNE 16 & 17”; these are event dates, not a news publication date. This is the next announced edition after the completed June 17–18, 2026 event.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: the 157-room Harbourfront hotel is a plausible city-hotel base for a limited exhibitor, speaker, executive or international-delegation block serving Exhibition Place. It is not a resort-led event and there is no sourced resort requirement. Do not propose exclusive accommodation or the main trade show/conference: the historical 2026 forecast was 5,000 attendees, far beyond this hotel’s inventory and approximately 240-theatre largest-room capacity. A 15–109 peak-room discussion range is a sales-sizing hypothesis from the hotel brief, NOT published event demand or a forecast. Side meetings may fit subject to programme, availability, AV and catering checks. Do not promise restaurant/lounge or reception catering. No event-to-hotel walking time or transfer arrangement has been verified.
findings.venueCommitments: Organizer-announced venue: Enercare Centre at Exhibition Place, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. This is Toronto proper and inside the hotel’s Exhibition Place territory, not the historical International Centre in Mississauga. The official 2027 booth page states: “This year we are moving to the Enercare Centre at The Exhibition Place, Toronto.” This establishes an announced venue, not access to the executed venue contract; hall allocation and contractual terms are not verified. Enercare Centre is an exhibition/convention venue, not a competing accommodation hotel.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified timeline: June 15–16, 2022 (first edition; venue unverified); June 20–21, 2023, International Centre, Mississauga; June 18–20, 2024, International Centre Hall 5, Mississauga; May 13–14, 2025, same Hall 5; June 17–18, 2026, International Centre, Entrance 5, Mississauga. The announced 2027 move is to Toronto proper. This is repeated Greater Toronto Area activity, not evidence of a rotating national destination programme. TRACCS explicitly calls Rail Day annual; exact dates have varied.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027: no edition-specific host hotel, hotel block, housing bureau appointment, booking link or open hotel RFP was found in the reviewed official 2027 material. Sourcing is unconfirmed, not open. Historical 2026 evidence is explicit: “HOTEL ROOM BLOCKS Facilitated by HPN Global” and “HPN Global, led by Cheryl Pineo, provides hotel site selection and sourcing support”. The page describes RFP support and contract negotiation. It also says “TRACCS does not utilize a housing service” and “The only Hotel Courtesy Blocks facilitated by TRACCS are listed here”; distinguish this courtesy-block/site-selection arrangement from an appointed centralized housing bureau. Every hotel listed for 2026: Hilton Garden Inn Toronto Airport; Hilton Toronto Airport Hotel & Suites; Hyatt Place Toronto Airport; GLō by Best Western Mississauga; Hilton Mississauga / Meadowvale; Four Points by Sheraton Toronto Airport; Element Toronto Airport. None is verified as a 2027 incumbent.
findings.organizationStructure: TRACCS expands to Transit Rail Association for Canadian Contractors, Maintainers, Operators and Standards. It self-identifies as a non-profit association of contractors, operators and maintainers, not a corporate exhibitor, PCO or DMC. Rail Day is its association-led passenger-rail trade show and conference. HPN Global is a separately named historical accommodation/site-selection intermediary; Rail.S coordinates the proposed ERCI delegation rather than owning Rail Day. No appointed 2027 PCO/DMC was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: 2026 lodging was already offered through seven named airport/Mississauga-area hotels. The historical page labels Hilton Mississauga / Meadowvale, Four Points by Sheraton Toronto Airport and Element Toronto Airport “FULL”, Hilton Garden Inn “FILLING QUICKLY”, and Hilton Toronto Airport “GOING FAST”. These are historical page labels, not verified current availability or evidence of 2027 overflow. Its World Cup-related scarcity and pricing warnings concern June 2026 only and must not be carried into 2027. No 2027 hotel exclusivity, sell-out or displaced room demand is sourced.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Andrea at andrear@traccs.ca, copying railday@traccs.ca. Reference the June 16–17, 2027 Enercare move; ask who owns accommodation sourcing, whether Cheryl Pineo/HPN Global remains appointed, which hotels are committed, and whether a courtesy block or exhibitor/speaker sub-block can still be considered. Request 2026 pickup and 2027 out-of-town room requirements, arrival/departure pattern, budget, commissions, transport expectations and decision timetable before quoting. If HPN is retained, submit through that channel rather than bypassing it. In parallel, approach Anne Dombrowe at anne.dombrowe@rail-s.de to verify the delegation is proceeding and whether it needs consolidated lodging; acknowledge the expired interest deadline and corrected Toronto venue. Offer a capacity-controlled city-hotel option, not a full-event housing promise; verify hotel inventory and catering operations first.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the current sales target, the upcoming 2027 edition, event dates and venue are announced and booth sales are open, but booth availability does not imply hotel sourcing is open. Organizer outreach is accessible through Andrea and railday@traccs.ca; a lodging opportunity remains conditional on existing commitments, sourcing ownership and actual travelling cohorts. The 2026 hotel blocks are historical and cannot be sold as current inventory.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: the 2027 move from Mississauga to Exhibition Place strengthens the relevance of a Harbourfront lodging proposal versus historical airport blocks, but does not establish that existing hotel contracts have been displaced. The ERCI/Rail.S delegation is a specific international prospect: its final scope is conditional on participant interest. Its page retains the old International Centre location, superseded by the organizer’s Enercare announcement, and its October 31, 2026 interest deadline has passed. Reconfirm whether participation remains possible. Recurrence supports relationship development for later cycles; no later-edition date or venue is established here.
